Svelte does not see changes inside a `Date`, `Map`, `Set`, `URL` or `URLSearchParams`. Where one is changed, such as by `set()`, `add()` or `setHours()`, the reactive class of `svelte/reactivity` updates what shows it. In a `.svelte.js` or `.svelte.ts` file the rule also reports one that is exported.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/prefer-svelte-reactivity": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<script>
  const items = new Map();
  items.set("apple", 1);
</script>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<script>
  import { SvelteMap } from "svelte/reactivity";

  const items = new SvelteMap();
  items.set("apple", 1);
</script>
```
